Chapter 595: Chapter 28: Stars Fall Like Rain On Earth (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 595: Chapter 28: Stars Fall like Rain on Earth (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

The Prime God surveyed his surroundings, “First, let’s see what the Longshan Patriarch has to say. If he’s willing to share the opportunity of the Supreme God with us, we can allow him to join us.”

This statement immediately won the approval of the other Prime Gods.

If they could obtain the opportunity of the Supreme God “peacefully,” they naturally wouldn’t want to fight desperately.

Who knows what kind of cards the Longshan Patriarch holds, for him to dare come knocking so boldly. He must be confident.

Even though they, the twenty-four Prime Gods, were confident in suppressing the Longshan Patriarch, they might still be forcefully “exchanged” by him for a few of their number.

No Prime God was confident that they wouldn’t be the ones “exchanged.”

...

…

“This Spatial Layer has been sealed?” Lin Yuan, having only just arrived at the Ocean of Light, immediately noticed the changes in the spatial layer.

“Such a feeble seal.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. With his power, he only needed to gently tear it to shatter such a seal.

However, his purpose for coming here was for the divine lattices of the gods. The sealing of the Ocean of Light was precisely to Lin Yuan’s liking.

While Lin Yuan was pondering,

several figures began to appear in the distance.

They were the many True Gods who had been ordered by the Prime God to hurry over.

“Is that the Longshan Patriarch?”

“Fortuitously gained the opportunity of the Supreme God?”

“The Supreme God, oh, that’s an existence even we True Gods can’t look up to…”

“I had always thought the Supreme God was a fiction. I didn’t expect he really existed…”

…

The many True Gods looked at Lin Yuan with various emotions in their eyes: awe, greed, excitement, curiosity, and more.

Whoosh.

Whoosh.

Whoosh.

Just then,

Twenty-four figures silently appeared above the many True Gods.

These twenty-four figures seemed eternal, emanating an almost immortal aura.

“Twenty-four Prime Gods? The twelve Prime Gods from the dark abyss have also come?”

“It seems today the Longshan Patriarch is in great peril…”

“The opportunity of the Supreme God, if the Prime Gods can vie for it, so can I.”

The various True Gods had different thoughts. In their eyes, Longshan Yuan was merely a common Viscount heir among mortals, who, after gaining the opportunity of the Supreme God, had suddenly reached this level of strength.

If that opportunity of the Supreme God fell into their hands, might they not hope to surpass the Prime Gods?

“Longshan Patriarch.”

Just then, a towering Prime God with golden dragon horns on his head spoke.

He was the Rainbow Dragon God, the source of faith for all dragons in the world. Strictly speaking, the Rainbow Dragon Clan bloodline within Lin Yuan came from this Prime God.

“What brings you here today?” the Rainbow Dragon God inquired, staring at Lin Yuan.

Although he greatly desired the opportunity of the Supreme God within Lin Yuan, the more it was at times like these, the less he could afford to show any impatience.

“I have come here to propose a trade,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

He looked at the many True Gods and the twenty-four Prime Gods, his heart also full of expectation. How many layers would these divine lattices and True God forms expand his Spatial Layers to?

“A trade?”

“You want to negotiate a trade with us?”

The Rainbow Dragon God was slightly taken aback, as were the other twenty-three Prime Gods.

“What trade?”

The Prime God of Light directly asked.

“I would like to borrow everyone’s divine lattice,” Lin Yuan said.

Upon hearing this,

not only did the twenty-four Prime Gods fall silent,

but the many True Gods below also fell silent.

The divine lattice is the absolute core of a deity. Handing over one’s divine lattice to someone else is tantamount to entrusting them with one’s life.

Especially for the Prime Gods, their status stems from their True God Forms,

handing over the True God Form, should Lin Yuan harbor ill intentions, they would be doomed without redemption.

“Longshan Patriarch, you are too arrogant,” the Dark God said coldly, “You want us to hand over our divine lattice? What do you intend to offer in exchange?”

Though there was no agreement to Lin Yuan’s proposal, the Dark God still wished to know what Lin Yuan had in mind for the trade.

“As long as you hand over your divine lattices, I will spare your lives,” Lin Yuan said frankly.

“Hahahahahaha, it seems, Longshan Patriarch, you are quite confident in dealing with us?”

“And you’ll spare us? Today, you better just stay put in the Ocean of Light.”

Many Prime Gods and True Gods were amused, even though Lin Yuan demonstrated spatial skills surpassing those of ordinary Prime Gods.

But now, they had twenty-four Prime Gods and a large number of True Gods. Even if the strength of the Longshan Patriarch was formidable, it was impossible for him to contend against them.

The power held by the twenty-four Prime Gods corresponded to the Origin Source forces of this realm, which was why they were confident they could suppress Lin Yuan.

As long as they joined forces, no one could stop them unless it was the Supreme God himself.

“It seems negotiations are off the table.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; persuading the gods to voluntarily hand over their Divine Lattice was indeed challenging.

However, for Lin Yuan, the impact wasn’t significant; he could simply take it himself if needed.

“Longshan Patriarch, hand over the Supreme God Opportunity, and we will let you go.”

The Main God of Rank spoke up, originally, his subordinate spirits had planned to recruit the Longshan Patriarch, thus he still harbored a sense of compassion towards Lin Yuan.

“Right, hand over the Supreme God Opportunity, and all will be well.”

“The opportunity of the Supreme God is not something you can enjoy alone.”

The other Prime Gods immediately said, staring intently at Lin Yuan, their eyes filled with longing.

They no longer hid their intentions, directly demanding the Supreme God’s opportunity from Lin Yuan. As for whether this would enrage the Supreme God?

If the Supreme God truly did not wish them to obtain the Supreme Opportunity, the Prime Gods wouldn’t have had any contact with Lin Yuan at all.

Since up to this point, the Supreme God had given no indication, it meant that the Supreme God’s opportunity in the hands of the Longshan Patriarch could be seized.

“The Supreme God’s Opportunity?”

Lin Yuan raised an eyebrow. “Never mind, there’s no point in arguing with you.”

“Since you all wish to die, I will satisfy you.”

Upon saying this.

All the True Gods were a bit astonished, and the twenty-four Prime Gods tensed up.

Although they were greedy, reason still prevailed; considering how domineering the Longshan Patriarch had been up to this point, could he really possess the power to sweep through numerous True Gods and the twenty-four Prime Gods?

However.

Before the True Gods and the twenty-four Prime Gods could react.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, instantly occupying a billion and two hundred million Spatial Layers, and a terrifying force swept over all True Gods and Prime Gods.

“This—”

The first to feel despair were the many True Gods, who immediately sensed everything about themselves beginning to shatter, their Physical Souls and more.

“No—”

A large number of True Gods turned into dust, even the oldest Upper-Rank Gods were unable to resist even a fraction of Lin Yuan’s strike and their wills instantly plunged into darkness, leaving only their sparkling Divine Lattices in place.

Hu hu hu～

A billion and two hundred million Spatial Layers shook back and forth, quickly enveloping the twenty-four Prime Gods. Each Prime God looked terrified; they tried to hide deeper into the Spatial Layers, only to find every layer they could occupy was also covered by Lin Yuan’s strike.

…

Longshan Ling.

Outside the Longshan Great Hall.

The members of the Longshan Family were still excitedly discussing.

“Was that the Ocean of Light just now?”

“The holiest world where the gods reside, I didn’t expect the Patriarch could enter whenever he wanted.”

“Nonsense, with the Patriarch’s strength evident, even in the Ocean of Light, he must be among the most formidable spirits, just below the Prime Gods.”

The faces of the people from the Longshan Family were full of pride.

“Right, just now the Patriarch mentioned negotiating a deal with the gods, what does that mean?”

A family member seemed to think of something and couldn’t help but raise their own question.

“Should be just the normal meaning of a trade, right?”

“Not sure, but since it’s a negotiation, it could either succeed or fail.”

“Right, but what if the Patriarch fails to negotiate with the gods?”

The members of the Longshan Family thought about it, and couldn’t help but show a worried expression on their faces.

Hopefully, the Patriarch didn’t already have a conflict or misunderstanding with the gods just after entering the Ocean of Light.

Just then.

A family member from the Longshan Family seemed to have noticed something, their voice trembling a bit, “Look up at the sky.”

“The sky?”

Though puzzled, the people of the Longshan Family looked toward the expanse above.

But upon doing so, they witnessed a scene they would never forget in their lifetimes.

They saw that, originally in the firmament above, eternal stars were suspended.

However, under everyone’s incredulous gazes—

One of the stars began to fall, followed by a cluster of stars falling, and then, stars across the entire firmament fell.

Dense and numerous stars, suspended in the sky for perhaps tens of thousands of years, all began to fall simultaneously, like a meteor shower.

Stars rained down upon the earth.
